assets.prompt:
[PHOTO STYLE LOCK]
A REAL black-and-white documentary photograph, not a render, not an illustration, not "AI art".

CAMERA & FILM LOOK
- Shot on a full-frame camera (e.g. Leica M11 Monochrom or Sony A7 IV) with a 35mm or 50mm prime lens at f/2–f/2.8, ISO 800–1600.
- The tonal look of Ilford HP5 / Kodak Tri-X 400 film: real, fine, uneven film grain across the WHOLE image, including skin and shadows (not a flat digital noise overlay).
- Natural lens behaviour: real shallow depth of field with optically correct background blur, slight softness and gentle vignetting toward the edges, minor chromatic falloff. The focus plane is sharp on the eyes or hands, and everything else falls off naturally.
- Natural available light only (window light, overhead fluorescent, shop pendant lamps, kitchen heat lamps) with realistic light falloff and real, slightly messy shadows. No studio beauty lighting, no rim-light halo, no glow.

SKIN (critical)
- Real human skin at a close-up level of detail: visible pores, fine lines, small natural blemishes, uneven texture, tiny hairs on arms and face, natural oil sheen on the forehead, nose and cheekbones, slight sweat where the scene is warm (kitchens, salons).
- Dark skin correctly exposed for black and white: expose FOR the skin, keeping rich tonal detail in faces and hands. Highlights sit on the cheekbones, brow, nose bridge and knuckles. Never crush faces into flat black, and never grey them out.
- Faces are naturally asymmetric with real character: individual features, natural teeth (not perfectly white or even), real eyes with natural catchlights from the actual light source, and stray eyebrow hairs.
- ABSOLUTELY NO skin smoothing, beauty filter, airbrushing, wax or porcelain look, or plastic sheen.

HAIR, HANDS, CLOTHES, OBJECTS
- Hair: individual strands, flyaways, frizz and real braid texture with slightly uneven partings, real cornrow and fade lines.
